Investors.alafia_is_a_6igma_health_platf.source: ALAFIA is a 6igma health platform. It unifies labs, medications, nutrition, fitness, mental health and clinical care into a single model of a person, and puts an intelligent agent on top of that model rather than beside it.

Investors.data_sharing_plugs_into_clinic.source: Data sharing plugs into clinical workflows instead of living beside them. That is what turns a consumer app into something a health system or an insurer buys.

Investors.global_spanning_wellness_healt.source: Global, spanning wellness, health, fitness, nutrition and public health.

Investors.nutrients_medications_labs_fit.source: Nutrients, medications, labs, fitness, environment and mental health feed one view of a person — a 360° picture with no gap.

Investors.physician_sharing_is_the_wedge.translation: El intercambio con médicos es la clave

Investors.the_entry_point_is_chronic_dis.source: The entry point is chronic disease — ESRD and dialysis, diabetes, and anyone whose condition has to be managed daily rather than occasionally. That cohort needs the “distance from a stable operating manifold” framing every day, is the most expensive population in the system, and is where the return is clearest to patients, clinicians, administrators and insurers alike.
Investors.the_entry_point_is_chronic_dis.translation: El punto de entrada es la enfermedad crónica — ESRD y diálisis, diabetes, y cualquiera cuya condición deba gestionarse diariamente en lugar de ocasionalmente. Esta población necesita el enfoque de "distancia de una variedad estable de operación" cada día, es la más costosa del sistema, y es donde el beneficio es más claro para pacientes, clínicos, administradores y aseguradores.

Privacy.alafia_has_no_age_limit_health_i.source: ALAFIA has no age limit. Health is a lifelong concern, and a parent tracking a child's condition is a case we build for deliberately rather than one we exclude.
Privacy.alafia_has_no_age_limit_health_i.translation: ALAFIA no tiene límite de edad. La salud es una preocupación de por vida, y un padre que controla la condición de un hijo es un caso que construimos deliberadamente, no uno que excluimos.

Privacy.alafia_helps_you_organise_and_un.source: ALAFIA helps you organise and understand your health information. It does not replace your clinician. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Privacy.alafia_holds_some_of_the_most_se.source: ALAFIA holds some of the most sensitive information a person has. This page explains plainly what we collect, why, who can see it, and how to get it back or delete it.
Privacy.alafia_holds_some_of_the_most_se.translation: ALAFIA contiene información muy sensible. Esta página explica claramente qué recopilamos, por qué, quién puede verlo, y cómo recuperarlo o eliminarlo.

Privacy.alafia_runs_on_google_cloud_in_t.source: ALAFIA runs on Google Cloud in the United States, and your records are stored in an encrypted database there. Data travels over encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
Privacy.alafia_runs_on_google_cloud_in_t.translation: ALAFIA funciona en Google Cloud en Estados Unidos, y tus registros se almacenan en una base de datos cifrada allí. Los datos viajan por conexiones cifradas (HTTPS/TLS).

Privacy.alafia_s_ai_features_are_answere.source: ALAFIA's AI features are answered by established model providers we work with. Before a request leaves ALAFIA it is de-identified at a single point that every AI call passes through: your name, email address, phone number, date of birth, record numbers and the names of clinicians you mention are removed, and you are represented by a token we issue — something like
Privacy.alafia_s_ai_features_are_answere.translation: Las funciones de IA de ALAFIA son proporcionadas por proveedores de modelos establecidos con los que trabajamos. Antes de que una solicitud salga de ALAFIA, se desidentifica en un único punto por el que pasa cada llamada de IA: tu nombre, correo electrónico, número de teléfono, fecha de nacimiento, números de registro y los nombres de los médicos que mencionas se eliminan, y se te representa con un token que emitimos — algo como
